summary: Globavend Holdings Ltd, a Cayman Islands exempted company, filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, disclosing a Standby Equity Purchase Agreement (SEPA) with YA II PN, Ltd. The investor agreed to purchase up to $20 million of ordinary shares over 36 months at pricing options of 93% of VWAP on the same trading day or 96% of the lowest daily VWAP over three consecutive trading days. A structuring fee of $35,000 and a commitment fee of $200,000 are payable. There are no mandatory drawdowns, no non-usage fees, and a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap. This is a flexible equity facility for working capital, not a special situation.
